draft.reply: {"reply": "Hi, thanks for reaching out! Seeing two different charges in the same month usually isn't a mistake -- it typically happens when your workspace's member count crosses a plan threshold mid-cycle. That triggers a prorated charge for the remainder of the current billing cycle, in addition to your regular renewal charge for the next cycle. Since your two charges ($135 and $27) are different amounts, this matches that pattern. You can confirm the details by going to Settings > Billing > Invoices, where each charge should appear as a separate line item explaining what it's for. Let us know if the line items don't add up or you have any other questions!", "citations": ["billing_faq.md#i-was-charged-twice-this-month-what-happened", "billing_faq.md#when-am-i-charged", "billing_faq.md#how-do-i-get-an-invoicereceipt"]}
